nodes.description: Immutable ADMIN address in BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy, used as the sole access-control authority for admin-only functions.
Constant bytes32 EIP-1967 storage slot IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT holding the delegatecall target address.
Modifier ifAdmin: if msg.sender == ADMIN the body executes, otherwise execution is routed to _fallback().
external admin() returns ADMIN, guarded by ifAdmin.
external implementation() returns _implementation(), guarded by ifAdmin.
external upgradeTo(address) calls _upgradeTo, guarded by ifAdmin.
external payable upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) upgrades implementation then delegatecalls admin-supplied data.
_willFallback in BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy: requires msg.sender != ADMIN to block admin fallback path.
_willFallback override in InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy delegating to the base implementation.
_implementation() reads IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT through inline assembly sload.
_upgradeTo(address) sets the implementation and emits Upgraded.
_setImplementation(address) validates the target is a contract then sstores it into the implementation slot.
fallback() external payable forwards execution to _fallback().
_delegate(address) forwards full calldata to the implementation via delegatecall and bubbles returndata.
_willFallback() empty virtual hook in Proxy, overridden by derived contracts.
_fallback() calls _willFallback() then _delegate(_implementation()).
Address.isContract(address) checks extcodehash against the empty-code hash to detect contracts.
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256) transfers ether via a low-level call{value:}.
public payable initialize(address,bytes) sets the implementation and delegatecalls init data when non-empty.
Constructor of InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy forwarding the admin argument to the base constructor.
Constructor of BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy assigning the immutable ADMIN.
msg.sender compared against the immutable ADMIN inside the ifAdmin modifier.
msg.sender checked in _willFallback to prevent the proxy admin from entering the fallback path.
delegatecall inside Proxy._delegate forwarding arbitrary calldata to the implementation address.
delegatecall to newImplementation with admin-supplied data in upgradeToAndCall.
delegatecall to _logic with _data performed during initialize.
recipient.call{value: amount}('') external value transfer in Address.sendValue.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read by the ifAdmin modifier to decide whether the guarded body or the fallback runs.
msg.sender from the modifier is compared with the immutable ADMIN to authorize admin calls.
admin() returns the ADMIN state variable.
ifAdmin gates execution of admin().
ifAdmin gates execution of implementation().
ifAdmin gates execution of upgradeTo().
ifAdmin gates execution of upgradeToAndCall().
Non-admin callers inside ifAdmin are routed to _fallback().
msg.sender is required to differ from ADMIN in _willFallback.
BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback invokes super._willFallback().
The initializable proxy override forwards to BaseImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback().
_fallback first calls the _willFallback hook.
_fallback delegates execution through _delegate.
_fallback resolves the target address via _implementation().
_delegate executes the delegatecall opcode on the implementation address.
Delegatecall executes untrusted implementation code with the proxy storage, allowing re-entry into proxy entry points.
The fallback() function forwards to _fallback().
When the caller is not admin, admin() path diverts into _fallback().
implementation() reads the address via _implementation().
upgradeTo calls internal _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall calls internal _upgradeTo before the delegatecall.
upgradeToAndCall performs the delegatecall to newImplementation with data.
The delegatecall target executes arbitrary code in proxy context and can re-enter upgrade/admin functions.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation to write the new address.
_setImplementation validates the target with Address.isContract.
_implementation reads the value stored at IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
_setImplementation writes the new implementation into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
initialize requires _implementation() to be address(0).
initialize sets the initial implementation through _setImplementation.
initialize delegatecalls _data on _logic when data length is non-zero.
The initialization delegatecall runs untrusted logic that could re-enter initialize before state is finalized.
initialize asserts the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant against the derived EIP-1967 hash.
sendValue performs the low-level value call to recipient.
The value-transferring external call hands control to the recipient, which may re-enter the calling contract.

The initializable proxy constructor chains into the base immutable-admin constructor.
The admin constructor argument becomes the immutable ADMIN authority.
